## Expectation recorded before replay

The DEGRADED share is 9.8% (< 10%): the surface is cliff-like. From the turbofan and simulator sweeps, the ranking should hinge on the few prompts where strategies differ in severity or sensor routing, and should be sensitive to the HIGH multiplier.

Only Xs0, Xs1, Xs2 and Xs12 (plus W0/W2 between operating conditions) carry signal on this checkpoint, so prompts routed to motor, oil, coolant or electrical sensors can act only through their correlated Xs2 component.
